entries.title: Your crew reaches Bitbucket the way it reaches GitHub and GitLab
entries.body: On a Bitbucket project, your crew can now read and change things on bitbucket.org within the project's own repository, read its pipelines and a step's log, and put a release file in its Downloads. A change anywhere else still waits for your click, and merging still goes through the merge card. New comments on a crewmate's pull request wake it. If you have a panel of your open changes, it now lists your Bitbucket pull requests with their builds' status. Bitbucket offers no download of a pipeline's artifacts, so the crew reads the step's log instead.

picture.alt: The Open changes panel listing three Bitbucket pull requests, numbered #42, #17 and #9, one a draft, each with a dot for its builds' status.
